title: Lives of the Necromancers
summary: "Lives of the Necromancers" by William Godwin is a historical account published in 1834. Godwin's final book examines paranormal legends and magical beliefs from western and Middle Eastern history, tracing tales of sorcery, witchcraft, and supernatural powers from ancient civilizations through the Dark Ages. The work explores how superstitions originated before the Scientific Revolution, covering figures from the Bible, Greek and Roman legends, medieval Europe, and the persecution of suspected witches, ultimately chronicling humanity's enduring fascination with the mystical and unexplained.
